caption: The drawing depicts a rooster standing on top of a cylindrical spool. The rooster has a brown-red comb and wattle, a yellow beak, a white area around its eye, and dark eyes. Its neck and upper body feathers are reddish-brown, with the wing and lower body rendered in black or dark gray, blending into brown with hints of yellow. The tail feathers are a mix of dark brown, reddish, yellow, and gray, fanning outward. The rooster stands on two yellow legs with thin toes that rest on the flat top of the spool. The spool itself is cylindrical, with a brown circular top and bottom, and its middle section is wrapped with material exhibiting a mottled, dark gray and white pattern. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery. There is a small, neat signature to the left of the spool.
title: Toy Rooster
